900.3.10(354).explanation: Exception RD 354 sets a 1.2 m minimum side setback, a 4.5 m minimum setback from a side lot line on a street, and, on a list of named addresses on Highcastle Rd., Oakmeadow Blvd. and Stonefield Cres., a 13.5 m minimum lot frontage and 557 m2 minimum lot area. No former by-laws prevail.

900.3.10(540).explanation: Exception RD 540 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed in 2013 as the minimums, caps lot coverage at 50%, requires 3.0 m from street lot lines (6.0 m for a street-facing garage entrance, 7.5 m along Steeles Ave., Warden Ave. or Kennedy Rd.), allows a 1.0 m side setback on one side only, and requires the parking space inside the house. Schedule "C" Exception 13 of former Scarborough by-law 16762 also prevails.

900.3.10(323).explanation: Exception RD 323 keeps the lot frontage and lot area that existed in 2013 as the minimums, requires 7.5 m from a front lot line on Huntingwood Dr., 1.2 m from side lot lines and 4.5 m from a side lot line on a street, and lets a garage sit 0.3 m from an interior side lot line. Former Scarborough by-law 10717 exceptions prevail on 22 Rosscowan Cres. and 64 and 68 Wicklow Dr.

900.3.10(187).explanation: Exception RD 187 requires a 9.0 m front setback, a 0.9 m side yard setback and 4.5 m from a side lot line on a street, and the lands must also comply with exception 900.3.10(1462). No former by-laws prevail.
